ProtoTree is an interpretable model that combines a CNN with a prototype-based decision tree. Each node uses a learned prototype to route images based on visual similarity enabling clear step-by-step explanations. Despite its simplicity it achieves competitive accuracy with far fewer prototypes than ProtoPNet.

ProtoTree-MIL is an interpretable MIL framework for WSI classification that combines prototypes and decision tree. The fundamental distinction between ProtoTree-MIL and the original ProtoTree lies in their pooling strategy for handling large-scale inputs: while the vanilla ProtoTree employs a min-pooling operation to select only the single patch closest to a prototype, WSI—ProtoTree-MIL introduces an efficient attention-based pooling mechanism.
